api_analysis.hypothesis: The existing model_new.py calls four custom operators with explicit signatures: reflection_pad2d_forward, conv2d_forward, glu_forward, min_dim_forward. The .cu file already exports launchers for reflection_pad2d, glu and min_dim; conv2d must be implemented in the binding .cpp using cuDNN. The binding file must provide PyTorch wrappers, validate tensors, call the appropriate launchers or cuDNN, and register all four functions. All operators require float32 CUDA tensors with strided or contiguous layouts.

task_contract.json specifies data types and shapes; all inputs are float32 CUDA tensors, conv bias may be None.
binding_registry.h requires binding functions to be registered using REGISTER_BINDING(name, func) where func is a function taking pybind11::module&.
cuDNN is available for convolution implementation.
